descriptions.w3d_cc32b_pop_line_802cbb5c: When endpoint logging is enabled and the unsigned slot index is below sixteen, copies the first queued shared string into the original return buffer, shifts remaining four-byte handles forward with retain-before-release ownership, destroys the old final handle and returns the original buffer. Empty or disabled queues return null. Types and names are inferred; the four-byte element stride is observed, complete original class declarations are unknown. Referenced global queue storage and return buffer remain externally owned.
